joli_bookings.name: Francesca Heath
joli_bookings.feedback: Really enjoyed our recent visit to Maki & Ramen. The food was delicious, with plenty of choice and everything we tried was really fresh and full of flavour and came out really fast. The service was great from start to finish, and the atmosphere and decor made it such a lovely place to dine. Would definitely recommend and would happily visit again!

joli_bookings.feedback: We absolutely loved it and the staff were really helpful when talking about the dishes x

joli_bookings.name: Holly Newman
joli_bookings.feedback: Absolutely amazing! Staff were so friendly, food was unbelievable. We can't wait to come back

joli_bookings.name: Ambika Kale
joli_bookings.feedback: Great food, staff very friendly and polite. Easy process and great place

joli_bookings.name: Amanjit Heer
joli_bookings.feedback: Brilliant service from Joshi! Food was incredible. My partner and I visited one year ago for our first date and a year later we're back here for a collaboration. Maki and Ramen will definitely hold a special place for us. Joshi made this visit truly rememberable this time too! Hospitality from him was 10/10!

joli_bookings.name: Chevon Samuel
joli_bookings.feedback: We had such an amazing evening! From the moment we arrived, the service was spectacular, we felt so welcomed and genuinely looked after throughout the whole night. The food was even better, there wasn't a single thing we ordered that we didn't love. As parents, getting the chance to properly switch off, dress up and enjoy a date night together is always special, and this was honestly such a lovely one. We ate, laughed, talked and just enjoyed having that time together. It was one of those evenings where you leave feeling really happy that you went. We'll definitely be back!
